title: Multiplexed perturbation enables scalable pooled screens
contrast: CD54-low vs CD54-high sort, MOI 0.3, paired by replicate (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: ICAM1 (positive control) and new ICAM-1 regulators
barcs_calls: 1,533 genes at model FDR 0.10; 45 against an empirical null from 1,026 non-targeting guides
verdict: BARCS recovers the ICAM1 positive control (#7) with TRAF6, an NF-kB activator of ICAM1, at #4. Even non-targeting guides reproduce between replicates here, so the model FDR (1,533 genes) is unreliable; an empirical null from the controls gives 45.
